title: EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events
abstract: arXiv:2609.34007v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing tuples as text inflates sequence length and repeatedly encodes the same structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality and time gaps enter through a learned embedding and attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning them is challenging because clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events with few observations. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen, ontology-trained biomedical embedding of the event's clinical description, mapped into the input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. translated_title: EHRAdapt：利用语义先验将预训练语言模型适配到电子健康记录以应对罕见临床事件
translated_abstract: 电子健康记录（EHR）将临床病史编码为（时间、模态、代码）三元组，而预训练语言模型期望的是文本标记。将三元组序列化为文本会拉长序列长度，并反复编码相同的结构。我们提出了EHRAdapt，这是一种将三元组直接映射到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的适配器。模态和时间间隔通过可学习的嵌入和注意力偏置引入，事件代码则获得专用的向量。学习这些向量颇具挑战性，因为临床词汇表呈长尾分布，导致罕见事件只有极少量的观测数据。因此，EHRAdapt将每个事件向量表示为语义先验与证据残差之和。先验是基于本体训练得到的、冻结的生物医学嵌入，对应于该事件的临床描述，并通过共享的可学习投影映射到输入空间，因此即使观测数据稀缺，也能提供临床语义。残差是一个可学习的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EHRAdapt适配器，将电子健康记录的（时间、模态、代码）三元组直接映射进冻结语言模型的嵌入空间，并通过“语义先验+证据残差”的事件向量表示方法，解决了临床词汇长尾分布下罕见事件难以学习的问题。
en_tdlr: EHRAdapt is an adapter that maps (time, modality, code) EHR tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space, representing each event vector as a semantic prior plus an evidence residual to tackle rare clinical events arising from long-tailed clinical vocabularies.
